objective:
A Node.js library that turns long URLs into short codes and back.

It should provide: a deterministic base62 encoder and decoder over integers; a
store mapping short codes to target URLs with collision handling; validation
that rejects URLs without a scheme or host; optional custom aliases with a
reserved-word list; and hit counting per code.

Pure Node standard library, tested with the built-in test runner. No
third-party dependencies.
